form.nameEnHint: Optional. Used to suggest the slug.

specs.title: Specifications
specs.hint: Shown on the product page and used to compare products. Pick the spec type from the list so it lines up with other products.

form.activeHint: When off, the product is hidden from the site.
form.featuredHint: Can be shown in the featured products section on the homepage.
form.bestsellerHint: Shown in the best sellers section.
form.newOverrideHint: Automatic: the product counts as new based on when it was added.
form.sortOrderHint: A lower number appears earlier. Default is 0.
form.aliasesHint: Alternative names or common misspellings, one per line or comma-separated. Example: iphone, ايفون.
